title: German Studies Research Grant
summary: Funding for research visits to Germany of 1-2 months for qualified North American students, graduates, and doctoral candidates carrying out research projects on German cultural studies.

degree_levels.notes: Aimed at undergraduates, graduates, and doctoral candidates/PhD students.

subject_areas.notes: Subjects relating to German affairs and German cultural studies.

institutions.notes: Universities or non-university institutes, archives and research institutes in Germany.

nationality.notes: Aimed at qualified students, graduates and doctoral candidates from North America (specifically Canada and United States of America).

residence.notes: Applicants from North America living in Canada or the United States of America.

mandatory.text: Carrying out research projects on German cultural studies
Qualified students, graduates and doctoral candidates

funding.description: A contribution towards travel and accommodation expenses of from 2,000 to 3,000 USD depending on length of stay.

application_rounds.notes: No specific deadline dates mentioned on the page.
